title: Average-Case Reductions for $k$-XOR and Tensor PCA
summary: We study the computational properties of two canonical planted average-case problems -- noisy planted $k$-XOR and Tensor PCA -- by formally unifying them into a family of planted problems parametrized by tensor order $k$, number of entries $m$, and noise level $δ$. We build a wide range of poly-time average-case reductions within this family, across all regimes $m \in [1, n^k]$.
